description: Defines the ResourcePermission class used for managing CRUD permissions within the OrangeHRM system. Implements permission combination and static factory methods.

classes.name: ResourcePermission
classes.description: A class representing CRUD permissions for a resource, including methods for combining permissions and creating instances from arrays or DataGroupPermission objects.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns true if read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns true if create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns true if update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns true if delete permission is granted.

methods.name: andWith
methods.description: Returns a new ResourcePermission combining current and given permissions with logical AND.

methods.name: orWith
methods.description: Returns a new ResourcePermission combining current and given permissions with logical OR.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a ResourcePermission instance from an array of permission flags, with an optional default value.

methods.name: createFromDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Creates a ResourcePermission from an external DataGroupPermission object.
